 "study": "not provided in article",
 "design": "parallel 2-arm",

 "duration": "18 months",
 "n_randomized_total": "92",
 "experimental_arm": {
  "label": "low-carbohydrate diet (LCD)",
  "intervention_description": "daily carbohydrate intake ≤ 90 g/d without total energy restriction; includes guidance on food servings (6 servings of carbohydrates), optional reduction of sulfonylurea and insulin to half doses for compliant patients",
  "n_randomized": "41",
  "n_analyzed": "41",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-1.44",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.30",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SD",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "9.95",
  "hba1c_baseline_sd": "1.04",
  "hba1c_final_mean": "6.84",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "0.59"
 },
 "control_arm": {
  "label": "traditional diabetic diet (TDD)",
  "intervention_description": "target total calories calculated as ideal weight × 25 kcal/kg for BMI 18.5–24, 20 kcal/kg for overweight/obese (BMI ≥24), 30 kcal/day for underweight (BMI <18.5); macronutrient percentages 50–60% carbs, 1.0–1.2 g/kg protein, ≤30% fat",
  "n_randomized": "42",
  "n_analyzed": "42",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-1.01",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.63",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SD",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "8.70",

  "hba1c_final_mean": "7.69",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "1.06"
 }
